verdict.rationale: Pendo's own Data Sync feature sends Pendo data onward to third-party data destinations: Snowflake, S3, Azure and Google Cloud. That is a genuine but narrow version of forwarding events to other systems. The generic integrations-library line names no event-forwarding destinations, and Slack alerts do not count as webhooks. missing for 10: evidence of real-time event streaming, CRM destinations, ad-platform destinations, registrable outbound webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform

citations.quote: Send your data direct to Snowflake, no engineering required—or configure your export for cloud storage.
Centralize insights from Pendo directly into Snowflake, S3, Azure, or Google Cloud for an instant, complete picture of your customer journey
